name: Yukimura Touko
source:
A senior in college. She is a member of the archaeology club.

Her father is the president of a mid-sized company, and her family is moderately well-off.
Until “Yuto” joined the club, she had been participating in club activities just to kill time.

People around her call her “Yuki-senpai.”
